derived_from: Revised Statutes §§ 1977-1980 jurisdictional provisions (1874), consolidated into 28 USC §1343 by the 1948 Title 28 enactment (62 Stat. 932, ch. 646)
notes: The jurisdictional grant for civil rights cases was originally embedded in §1 of the 1871 KKK Act (same provision as §1983). The 1874 codification separated it. The 1948 Title 28 enactment is the modern origin of §1343 as a distinct section.
